text:
The Nifty 50 closed at 25,884.5, up 0.25% on the day, while the broader Nifty 500 matched the move (up 0.25%). Advances outpaced declines (251 vs 242) and the breadth score stayed in the “HEALTHY” zone at 64.8, indicating a fairly broad rally across the market. The India VIX fell 4.7% to 16.84, showing reduced volatility, and both major indices remain above their 20‑day and 50‑day moving averages.

Foreign Institutional Investors (FIIs) were net buyers, adding INR 5,843.33 crore, while Domestic Institutional Investors (DIIs) bought INR 5,630.72 crore, marking the second consecutive day of DII buying. FIIs have been net long for 20 days. In the options market, Nifty’s put‑call ratio (PCR) is 1.03, with a max‑pain level around 25,800 and a call wall at 26,000, suggesting some resistance near that area. Bank Nifty’s PCR is 0.87, max‑pain at 63,500 and a call wall at 66,000, indicating bullish bias in the banking space. Leading sectors include Realty, PSU/Private banks, IT and FMCG, while Pharma, Auto and Infrastructure are weakening.

Watch the 25,800‑26,000 Nifty range and the 63,200‑66,000 Bank Nifty zone for the next session. Key levels are the Nifty pivot points (S1 25,753.68, P 25,864.32, R1 25,995.13) and Bank Nifty pivot (S1 63,210.15, P 63,657.45, R1 63,982.6). Any break of the call walls could trigger further moves, while a slip below the support walls (Nifty 25,000, Bank Nifty 65,000) would signal renewed caution.
